requestedMechanism: Fuse XXH32 hashing, UTF-8 validation, and copying for newly interned literal term keys in parse_and_encode_term_bank_token_binary_dedup.

controlFlow.finding: copy_valid_utf8 already combines UTF-8 validation and arena copying, including specialized valid multibyte widths. Partial failed writes are unpublished.
XXH32 is computed before the hash-table probe. A matched existing key returns its ID before any new-literal UTF-8/copy pass.
New-key count/table/capacity checks occur only after no match was found; only then is a literal validated and copied.
The validated bytes, hash, length, offset and ID are published together after copying succeeds.

ownershipAndCorrectness: Whether a literal is new is not known until its complete hash/table/equality probe finishes. A hash+copy pass before that decision would speculatively copy and validate nonadjacent duplicates that currently avoid those operations.

A duplicate currently can succeed without remaining arena space. Moving a capacity failure before the lookup would change fallback/error behavior. A correct speculative design needs a no-capacity fallback while preserving the existing shortcuts.
Existing empty/equal-reading and bounded adjacent-key reuse already avoid some hash/probe/copy work. Replacing them or increasing their bounds is outside this audit.
Hash arithmetic, table lookup, and mandatory copies cannot simply be removed. The potentially shared work is a source traversal on qualifying new literal keys; this is not a latency estimate.

corpusOpportunity.statement: 7,345,650 bytes bounds the byte volume of the new literal-key source traversal that might be shared with hashing; it is not a copy_valid_utf8 call count, whole-import speedup, peak-memory result, or bound on the cost of hashing all occurrences.
limitations: No isolated critical-path timing for copy_valid_utf8 is available in the retained trace analysis.
Generic hash samples include larger canonical-content work; they cannot be assigned wholesale to term keys.
The 7.0 MiB key arena is 7.26% of encoded content and 4.28% of decoded source by byte volume, which does not imply corresponding timing shares.

searchCoverage.method: GitHub PR/issue and branch search, followed by direct immutable source/patch inspection. Relevant PR/ref identities refreshed at audit completion.
searchCoverage.conclusion: No exact prior hash+UTF-8-validation+copy implementation for newly interned literal keys was identified in this bounded search. This is not a claim that every repository branch/history object was exhaustively searched.

recommendation: Do not prototype or open a PR on current evidence. Revisit only if fresh attribution identifies a material new-literal-key critical-path cost and a design removes a pass without speculative duplicate work, earlier capacity failure, changed validation, or overlap with adjacent-key studies.
